candidate.memoryForm: one all-or-nothing semantic-evidence and action capsule replacing only exact Base items from the selected same-source trajectory
candidate.semanticEvidence: all bounded primary accessibility values from the exact removed Base items, verbatim, deduplicated by support normalization, with source provenance and source order
candidate.feedbackRule: reuse D10 local deterministic progress to rank the owning trajectory and deliver only locally verified bounded actions
candidate.nullAction: exact Base on any ineligibility, overflow, ambiguity, corruption, timeout, or certificate failure

consumedAudit.claimRole: non-confirmatory recomputation on already consumed D9 development and validation questions

failureAnalysis.observedMechanism: Five of twelve direct-proxy test questions accepted D11 substitution, but D10, D11, and Base had exactly the same support on every direct question.
failureAnalysis.causalBoundary: D11 evidence is extracted only from Base items already selected for injection. It can preserve Base evidence and prevent D10-style loss, but cannot introduce a missing answer atom unless the inherited procedure action skeleton contributes it.
failureAnalysis.transferFinding: The inherited D10 procedure skeleton contributed no new supported answer atom on the untouched test. Consequently, D11 transferred as safe compression rather than memory-quality improvement.
failureAnalysis.feedbackFinding: Local feedback changed twenty contexts and saved 46.43 mean tokens relative to the agnostic arm, but changed direct support on zero questions. It remains a cost signal, not demonstrated quality self-optimization.
failureAnalysis.nextHypothesis: Use a bounded trajectory-coherent evidence expansion that can retrieve query-relevant semantic spans from the existing candidate pool outside the Base-injected prefix, then admit them only under exact provenance, replacement, cost, and dominance certificates. This changes evidence accessibility rather than retuning D11 compression.

evidenceBoundary: The consumed +6.79-point estimate selected and audited the representation but did not transfer to the untouched test.
The untouched result establishes zero effect only for the 12 direct-proxy questions in this frozen split; it is not a universal impossibility result.
Direct answer support is a representation proxy, not task accuracy, answer generation, or gold evidence recall.
No MiniMax-M3 or DeepSeek-V4Flash answer calls were made because the direct test gate failed.
LongMemEval-V2 is public long-horizon agent evidence, not internal multi-turn programming-session evidence.
